verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Deepgram's console, docs, or CLI that a user can hand tasks to. The Voice Agent API is a developer building block for constructing your own agents. The MCP server and the CLI's agent-environment detection serve external AI tools rather than providing an in-product assistant, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
